answer: Admission auction blocks Sybils by requiring a sealed-bid slot. Agents lock 70 credits and submit one sealed bid with a nonce. The auction closes, highest bid wins, losers get refunds, and the ledger records the slot. Auditors replay bids; duplicates or forgeries burn the bond. The k-th fake pays 45+6(k-1) credits, so 1,000 fakes pay 3,042,000 plus 70,000 locked. Honest agents pay 45 once and recover the bond, keeping river, karst, harbor open.
